info.name: Aegis API
info.description:
Content blocking, protection locks and accountability. No endpoint returns or stores a visited domain: blocked activity is a daily count.

Generated from http://localhost:3001/docs/json — re-run scripts/generate-postman.ts after changing any endpoint.
